public static final class RangedAttackTask.Builder extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage.Builder<RangedAttackTask.Builder> implements RangedAttackTaskOrBuilder
Maintains ranged spacing, leads the target, compensates for projectile
gravity, and fires a bow or crossbow.
